idea-plugin.name: SQL Server Docker Licence Lint
idea-plugin.description:
mssql docker licence check for compose, Kubernetes and Dockerfiles

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → SQL Server Docker Licence Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/mssql-container-licence-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/mssql-container-licence-lint

action.text: SQL Server Docker Licence Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run SQL Server Docker Licence Lint on the file in the editor
